public_balance_sheet_register.exposure_name: Deposit insurance, systemic-risk exceptions, and payment-continuity backstop
public_balance_sheet_register.legal_authority: Federal Deposit Insurance Act, FDIC Deposit Insurance Fund, systemic-risk exception authority, resolution/receivership law, special-assessment authority
public_balance_sheet_register.claimant_perimeter: Insured depositors, uninsured depositors in systemic cases, banks, creditors, small firms, payroll systems, communities, borrowers, future bank customers
public_balance_sheet_register.maximum_exposure: Explicit insured-deposit limit plus discretionary systemic-exception perimeter; practical exposure depends on deposit distribution, bank failures, DIF capacity, and systemic-risk determinations.
public_balance_sheet_register.expected_loss: Assessment-funded expected loss for ordinary failures; stress risk appears as special assessments, credit/fee pass-through, uninsured-depositor protection, or broader liquidity/market support.
public_balance_sheet_register.stress_scenario: Clustered bank failures or rapid deposit outflows trigger systemic-risk exception, converting selected uninsured depositors and market-continuity claims into public/backstop priorities.
public_balance_sheet_register.funding_source: DIF assessments, special assessments, receivership recoveries, liquidity facilities, and contingent public stability authority.
public_balance_sheet_register.loss_sharing: Equity and management first, then creditors/uninsured depositors absent systemic continuity need; special assessments should not quietly pass through to ordinary borrowers/depositors without incidence disclosure.
public_balance_sheet_register.public_upside_recovery: Resolution recoveries, clawbacks, penalties, special assessments, management accountability, and penalty pricing for extraordinary guarantees.
public_balance_sheet_register.ordinary_claimant_protection: Payroll, small-business operating accounts, household payment continuity, and insured depositors should be senior to large-cash-management and creditor protection.
public_balance_sheet_register.sunset_or_review: Quarterly with FDIC QBP and financial-stability reports; immediate review after any systemic-risk exception or material bank-failure cluster.

seniority_waterfall.stress_status: Can be protected for continuity, but must be separated from wealth/cash-management protection.
seniority_waterfall.notes: This can turn private cash-management choices into public stability claims.

seniority_waterfall.stress_status: Not automatically senior; systemic exception requires published incidence and loss-sharing rationale.
seniority_waterfall.notes: Resolution can wipe equity, but deterrence depends on enforcement.

seniority_waterfall.stress_status: Should bear loss or assessment before ordinary claimant haircut.
seniority_waterfall.notes: Special assessments can pass through to credit or fees.
